summary: Selectable first-person and orthographic isometric shooter camera provider with a follow camera, player floor marker and ViewModes service.
useWhen: A shooter-family game needs a toggleable overhead/isometric presentation over the same world while retaining its player controller and simulation.
limitations: Shooter-family camera role. The isometric view is an orthographic 3D projection of existing billboard actors, not a separate 2D renderer. It provides a generic floor marker but no player sprite, cutaway shader, wall transparency, zoom, pan or click picking. Pair with presentation/player-avatar for a body; core presentation must honor ViewModes to hide first-person-only view models and ceilings.
